title: The lower truncation kernel of a perfect affine lift is finite locally free
statement: Let X = Spec(A) be affine [def-pc-scheme] and let P^\bullet be a bounded-above complex of finite free A-modules [def-pc-perfect-complex] whose restriction to a quasi-compact open U represents a perfect object E of D(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex] of Tor amplitude in [a,b] [lem-pc-affine-tor-amplitude-criterion]. For any r<a, put K = Im(P^{r-1} \to P^r); on U the sheaf \widetilde K|_U coincides with the kernel of \widetilde{P^r}|_U \to \widetilde{P^{r+1}}|_U (the two A-modules Ker(P^r \to P^{r+1}) and Im(P^{r-1} \to P^r) need not agree on X). The restriction to U of the quasi-coherent sheaf \widetilde K associated to K is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] and of finite presentation, hence finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf].

proof.text: Test the given derived tensor vanishing against the tensor unit. The total tensor complex is naturally isomorphic to its K-flat representative by the right unitor. Apply Q homology comparison and the representing isomorphism to show the restricted complex is exact at r. The tilde functor preserves kernels by its fully faithful affine counit and quasi-coherence of kernels; as an additive left adjoint it also preserves colimits. Restriction and the over equivalence are exact. The image of the restricted preceding differential is consequently the restricted image. Exactness gives a kernel fork on that image, whose unique comparison to the chosen kernel satisfies the asserted inclusion identity. Use the private categorical generalization preservesFiniteLimits_of_kernel_in_essentialImage: an additive fully faithful functor between arbitrary abelian categories preserves finite limits if kernels of its mapped morphisms lie in its essential image. Lift and reflect a kernel fork to prove this general result. For tilde the sheaf kernel is quasi-coherent by lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel, hence its affine counit supplies the required essential-image isomorphism. No duplicate affine finite-limit theorem is stated.

proof.text: Choose the standard derived category of sheaves on Spec A. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors and mapHomologicalComplexCompIso identify derived restriction of Q(tilde P) with Q of the termwise restricted tilde complex. Transport the given Tor vanishing along this comparison and the representing isomorphism, then apply lem-sc-affine-truncation-kernel-flat with the same P, U, a, b, r.

proof.text: For each principal open inside U, the resulting localized linear range is flat and finitely presented. Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation makes it projective, and finite presentation implies finiteness. Apply lem-sc-principal-open-finite-projective-tilde to the linear range module. Transport finite local freeness through the canonical ModuleCat.imageIsoRange isomorphism.

proof.text: The source instance IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation gives finite presentation. Apply lem-sc-ext-tensor-exact to obtain left tensor exactness. The symmetric structure gives a natural isomorphism from left to right tensor, so finite limits and colimits are also preserved by right tensor, exactly the definition of SheafOfModules.IsFlat.
